"""Root-only lossless archive of actual native completion, assembly and helper receipts."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from common import (
    DOSSIER,
    PACKAGE,
    ROOT,
    bind,
    current,
    external_new,
    now,
    read,
    relative,
    verify,
    wrapper,
    write,
)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--native-completion", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--receipt", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    current()
    receipt = external_new(args.receipt)
    completion = read(args.native_completion)
    assert completion["status"] == "saved_review_and_history_checked"
    verify(completion["assembly"])
    for key in ["canonical_yaml", "canonical_markdown", "history"]:
        verify(completion[key])
    assembly_dir = Path(completion["assembly"]["path"]).parent
    native_dir = args.native_completion.parent
    package = read(PACKAGE / "handoff.json")
    verify(package["manifest"])
    manifest = read(package["manifest"]["path"])
    for row in manifest["artifacts"]:
        verify({**row, "path": str(PACKAGE / row["relative_path"])})
    sources = [
        ("helpers/" + row["relative_path"], PACKAGE / row["relative_path"])
        for row in manifest["artifacts"]
    ]
    sources += [
        ("helpers/handoff.json", PACKAGE / "handoff.json"),
        ("helpers/artifact-manifest.json", PACKAGE / "artifact-manifest.json"),
    ]
    for label, directory in [("assembly", assembly_dir), ("native", native_dir)]:
        for p in sorted(directory.rglob("*")):
            if p.is_file():
                assert not p.is_symlink()
                sources.append((label + "/" + str(p.relative_to(directory)), p))
    mappings, bodies = [], []
    for name, source in sources:
        name = relative(name)
        wrapped = source.suffix in {
            ".py",
            ".sh",
            ".txt",
            ".stdout",
            ".stderr",
            ".log",
            ".patch",
            ".diff",
            ".md",
        }
        destination = DOSSIER + "/finalization/" + name + (".json" if wrapped else "")
        dest = ROOT / destination
        assert not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink()
        assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in dest.parents if p.is_relative_to(ROOT))
        if wrapped:
            import json

            body = (json.dumps(wrapper(source), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()
        else:
            body = source.read_bytes()
        import hashlib

        mappings.append(
            {
                "relative_path": destination,
                "path": str(dest),
                "bytes": len(body),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
                "original": bind(source),
                "mode": "lossless_utf8" if wrapped else "exact",
            }
        )
        bodies.append((dest, body))
    assert len({x["relative_path"] for x in mappings}) == len(mappings)
    map_path = ROOT / DOSSIER / "finalization/archive-map.json"
    assert not map_path.exists()
    if args.apply:
        for dest, body in bodies:
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with dest.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(body)
        write(map_path, mappings)
    write(
        receipt,
        {
            "status": "archived" if args.apply else "dry_run_passed",
            "at": now(),
            "native_completion": bind(args.native_completion),
            "files": mappings if args.apply else [],
            "archive_map": bind(map_path) if args.apply else None,
            "maintained_copy_count": len(mappings) + 1 if args.apply else 0,
        },
    )
    print(bind(receipt))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
